description: Saves a new Discover query with a unique name for a Sentry organization, allowing reuse of search criteria for analyzing event data (errors, transactions) across specified projects and environments.

end.description: End date/time for the query's time range (ISO 8601). Takes precedence over `range`.
end.title: End

environment.description: List of environment names to filter by.
environment.title: Environment

fields.description: List of fields (e.g., `transaction`, `tag[tagName]`), functions (e.g., `count_if(...)`), or equations (prefixed with `equation|`) to include (max 20). See Sentry documentation for details.
fields.title: Fields

interval.description: Time series resolution for the chart (e.g., '1h', '30m', 'auto').
interval.title: Interval

name.description: Unique name for the saved query.
name.title: Name

orderby.description: Field or function from `fields` list to order results by (prefix with `-` for descending). Cannot be an equation.
orderby.title: Orderby

organization_id_or_slug.description: ID or slug of the Sentry organization.
organization_id_or_slug.title: Organization Id Or Slug

projects.description: List of project IDs to filter by; empty list implies all projects in the organization.
projects.title: Projects

query.description: Search query string using Sentry's syntax (e.g., `level:error transaction:/api/v1/*`).
query.title: Query

queryDataset.description: Dataset to query: `discover` (event properties/tags), `error-events` (error data), or `transaction-like` (transaction/performance data).
queryDataset.title: Query Dataset

range.description: Relative time range (e.g., '24h', '7d') if `start` and `end` are not provided.
range.title: Range

start.description: Start date/time for the query's time range (ISO 8601). Takes precedence over `range`.
start.title: Start

topEvents.description: Number of 'top events' timeseries for `top5` or `dailytop5` display types.
topEvents.title: Top Events

yAxis.description: List of aggregate functions for the y-axis of the chart visualization.
yAxis.title: Y Axis
